tasks.instruction: Open Facebook, search for tropical pictures, save one picture to your phone, go to the Wallpaper section in the Settings app, and set the saved picture as your wallpaper.
rubrics: Opened the Facebook app
Searched for tropical pictures
Viewed at least one post with a tropical picture
Saved one tropical picture to the phone
Opened the Settings app
Navigated to Wallpaper or Display settings
Set the saved picture as the wallpaper
human_reference_operations: tap on a post with a tropical image
tap on the image to view fullscreen
tap on three dots or options
select the saved tropical picture from gallery
set as wallpaper for Home screen or Lock screen

tasks.instruction: Open Chrome, search for the top Country songs of 2023, identify a song from the search results, then switch to Spotify and add that song to your playlist.
rubrics: Opened Chrome browser
Searched for top Country songs of 2023
Identified at least one Country song from the search results
Opened the Spotify app
Searched for the identified song in Spotify
Added the song to a playlist
human_reference_operations: scroll through search results and pick a song
select the correct song from results
tap on three dots or options
select a playlist or create a new one

tasks.instruction: Organize a movie night by choosing a horror film using Chrome, sending an invitation to one of your friends via Instagram, and setting a reminder in the Clock app for 8:35 PM on Sunday.
rubrics: Opened Chrome browser
Searched for a horror movie to watch
Selected a specific horror film
Opened Instagram app
Sent an invitation with movie details to a friend
Opened Clock app
Set a reminder or alarm for 8:35 PM on Sunday
human_reference_operations: scroll and choose a horror movie
tap on messages or select a friend
type and send movie night invitation with the movie title

tasks.instruction: Use the social media platform X to post a photo, copy the link to your post, then open Facebook and send the link to a friend
rubrics: Opened the social media platform X
Posted a photo on X
Copied the link to the post
Opened the Facebook app
Sent the copied link to a friend
human_reference_operations: tap on the post or create a new post
select the photo you want to upload
tap on the three dots or options menu of the post
tap on messages or select a friend
paste the copied link into the chat

tasks.instruction: Listen to a Reggaeton album on Spotify, then share the album's name with a friend on Facebook.
rubrics: Opened the Spotify app
Played a Reggaeton album
Identified the album's name
Opened Facebook app
Shared the album's name with a friend on Facebook

type the album's name in the chat
